name: unsafe fn into_box (self , len : usize) -> Box < [MaybeUninit < T >] , A >
rule: For safety, `len` must be less than or equal to `self.capacity()`, which may exceed the requested capacity if the allocator overallocated.
api: impl < T , A : Allocator > alloc::raw_vec::RawVec < T , A > { unsafe fn into_box (self , len : usize) -> alloc::boxed::Box < [MaybeUninit < T >] , A > }
